ticks.note: Both signals are emitted twice in one transition. `total` has `combine +`, so its emissions add up: 1 + 2 = 3. `latest` has no combine function, and within one transition the last emission wins: 2.
Both absent; both keep their values, 3 and 2.
`total` starts from 0 again in every tick, so it is 3 again, not 6.
